references.text: The same theme of seeking the Lord with all one's heart and all one's soul, which results in finding Him.
The great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart and all your soul, reflected in the call to return to God with all your heart.
Earlier in the same chapter, it describes turning back to the Lord with all one's heart and soul.
Explains what it means to keep the Lord's commandments and statutes written in the Book of the Torah.
Solomon's prayer describes returning to God with all one's heart and all one's soul.
The promise that you will find God when you seek Him with all your heart.
A call to return to the Lord with all one's heart.
Paul quotes from Deuteronomy 30 and explains how the word of faith is near, in the heart and on the lips.
Defines love for God as keeping His commandments, reflecting the requirement to keep the commandments in the Torah.
